description: Measured and forecasted total load on the Belgian grid (Historical data) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Measured and upscaled, most recent, day-ahead and week-ahead forecasts for total load on the Belgian grid. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Load. Its keywords are Consumption, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
